phase: Bounded investigation of the remaining one-tail case
trigger: Claude explicitly requests all tail shapes; F100 and F111 leave (10)^c110 unhandled.
stopping_event: First return to state C with all nonzero cells at or to the right of the head, after the initial rightward sweep; or halt; or the raw-transition bound.
evidence_rule: Exploratory endpoints are finite measurements. A fit alone is not a universal rule; closure requires a sweep derivation or formal proof.
forbidden_promotion: Neither a long derived prefix nor bounded word shape establishes infinite non-halting or a globally closed family.
